question: The Young Bengal Movement was started by _______ who had come to Calcutta in 1826 and was appointed in the Hindu College as a teacher of English literature and History.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Henry Lui Vivian Derozio.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Young Bengal Movement was introduced by **Henry Louis Vivian Derozio.__**
 
• Henry Vivian Derozio and the Young Bengal movement: 
 
 
• Henry Vivian Derozio was the leader of the Young Bengal Movement
 
• He was a teacher at the Hindu College, born in 1809 to a Portuguese father and Indian mother
 
• Derozio joined the college at 17 and taught there until 1831
 
• He was influenced by the ideals of liberty, equality, and fraternity
 
• Derozio drew a group of intelligent students around him, inspiring them to think freely and critically
 
• He organized debates and discussions on lit
